messages.author: 69dff70302d48f53
messages.subject: Error: could not find function "geditGrob"
parts:
Dear all,

I run a example in the book ggplot2: Elegant Graphics for Data Analysis （page 201-202, appendix C.4）,however I found a error:

> p <- qplot(wt, mpg, data = mtcars, colour = cyl)
> grob <- ggplotGrob(p)
> grob <- geditGrob(grob, gPath("strip", "label"), 
+ gp = gpar(fontface = "bold"))
Error: could not find function "geditGrob"
> grid.newpage()
> grid.draw(grob)


Is there a function similar to geditGrob() in ggplot2 0.9.0? 

Thanks~

--
Regards,
Taiyun
--

messages.subject: Re: Error: could not find function "geditGrob"

You're right, it was in ggplot2

https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/commit/1bc4d1e179536e3404418a9589d982c242a40793

you can simply use grid::editGrob instead with grep = TRUE, global = TRUE.

HTH,

baptiste

messages.author: 57af05ae927983df
messages.subject: Editing ggplot grobs ceased to work? [was: Re: Error: could not find function "geditGrob"]
parts:
Hi everyone,

I try to find ways to assess the grob objects for some time now. I tried to follow appendix C of the ggplot2 book. However, the code snippet in section C.4 ceased to work.

p <- qplot(wt, mpg, data = mtcars, colour = cyl)
grob <- ggplotGrob(p)

grob <- editGrob(grob, gPath("strip", "label"), gp = gpar(fontface = "bold"),
                 grep = TRUE, global = TRUE)

<error--- only gTree objects can be edited>

and if I use

p
grid.ls(ggplotGrob(p))

all I get is  "layout".

My actual problem is described here:

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/ggplot2/iygHrbUNy7w

As indicated in the linked post, I think that either the interfaces of ggplot2 or lattice have changed.
Or is ggplot no longer relying on lattice in the backend?

I need the margins to be nice in an automated way for a package I am currently writing (http://r-forge.r-project.org/projects/lethal/).

Can anyone give me any hints on how to proceed?

All the best,
Benjamin
